name: The Heliograph Prism, the Glasswright bomber wing craft (The Glasswrights)
notes: Issue 1373 (R362, R370: Ryan's Nov 16 W4b pick, re-picked Nov 20 2026): the Glasswright bomber wing craft, built from the build sheet tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/ithar_GW4.py on the shared Glasswright kit (tools/blender/kits/ithar, via ithar_GF1.py's machinery): two plump lobes fused side by side with a seafoam seam, two star torpedoes nested in the belly seam; opaque pearl ribbons and the glowing mosaic core; nothing see-through; no wear. LENGTH 1.6 (CLS_LEN Squadron). The game loads it through godot/render/squadron_wing.gd by its manifest wing_role (bomber).
